name: False Appearance (Ambush)
description: While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object; a creature must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check to tell it isn't real, and the creature has advantage on initiative rolls when it goes undetected.

mechanics.text: While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object; a creature must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check to tell it isn't real, and the creature has advantage on initiative rolls when it goes undetected.
While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal plant.

If the creature is motionless, has its eyes and mouth closed, and has its legs wrapped around its body at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the creature move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the creature is anything other than a creature.
While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from other large flowering plants.
While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal flower.
While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from ordinary kelp.
While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oily pool or wet rock.
While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary mound of mud.
While the creature remains motionless on the ceiling, it is indistinguishable from a normal stalactite.
While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a statue or a carved column.
Until the creature attacks, it is indistinguishable from a large school of fish.
While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a dead shrub.
While the creature remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a tangle of vines.
